run_diversity_cli: run the phyre diversity CLI to analyze solution power across task templates and tiers
compute_cache_power_of_solutions: compute solution power from partial simulation cache files for a given template and tier
compute_power_of_solutions: compute how many tasks each action solves using precomputed eval stats for a tier
print_stats: print a tabular summary of solution power statistics across template-tier pairs using parallel execution
main: load compiled tasks and print diversity stats for a specified template id and optional tier
